scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0144 staging draft; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target uses “Is this the reason?” and “Is that the reason?” are short, natural English for the scenario; dialogue turns were checked for agreement, tense, articles and punctuation.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: reason is consistently represented as «دلیل» in the selected sense, and Persian prompts preserve the English task meaning without adding unsupported context.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: A01 introduces the lexical meaning, A02 exposes the full dialogue, and all dialogue-dependent listening/reconstruction/retrieval occurs only afterward in A03, A06, A07 and A10.

distractorQuality.evidence: Choice distractors are grammatical, natural alternatives that change meaning or information rather than relying on malformed English.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: روبی و الکس بعد از تغییر زمان جلسه درباره دلیل آن صحبت می‌کنند.

difficultyFit.evidence: One new A1 lexical target (reason), consolidation of an already exposed interrogative be pattern, and one due review item keep the load controlled.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: reason appears in lexical recognition, guided dialogue, transfer, reconstruction and retrieval without introducing a second new lexical sense; problem remains review-only.

transferQuality.evidence: The lesson moves from “Is this the reason?” to “Is that the reason?”, changing the information while preserving the target sense and previously exposed construction.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, dialogue and activities all support the stated lexical outcome for reason; the be-interrogative form is treated as consolidation rather than claimed as a new grammar target.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed. Model/editor review checks runtime order, answer exposure, clarity and cognitive load only.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No image, photo or visual claim exists. Every listening/replay activity references T01–T04 turns marked audioRequired and first exposed through A02; no listening task points to an unreferenced media object.
